meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,当你把一段技术内容交给 Claude,它会用大白话把这件事拆开讲:涉及谁(who)、是什么(what)、在哪(where)、为什么(why)、何时(when),而不是只给一句笼统的解释。
howto.when: 当你觉得眼前的技术内容太难懂、想要一份大白话拆解时,这个技能会接管。

say.text: 这段说明太技术了,用大白话给我讲讲它的 who、what、why
这条报错我看不懂,帮我拆一下它的来龙去脉
say.note: 它会用日常语言说明发生了什么

say.text: 这个技术方案是谁做的、做什么、为什么这么做?
say.note: 它会照这五个维度分别回答

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you hand Claude something technical, it lays it out in plain English: the who, what, where, why, and when of it, instead of a single vague answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user finds something technical hard to follow and wants a plain-English breakdown of it.

say_en.text: This doc is too technical — break down the who, what, and why for me
I don't follow this error message; break down how it came about
say_en.note: It explains what happened in everyday words

say_en.text: Who built this technical approach, what does it do, and why?
say_en.note: It answers along those five dimensions
